conditions.description: Applications must be made jointly by the researcher and a beneficiary in the academic or non-academic sector; a sole researcher application without an institutional beneficiary is not eligible.

Participation is restricted to legal entities established in EU Member States, Iceland, Norway, and the following associated countries: Canada, Israel, Republic of Korea, New Zealand, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.
European Postdoctoral Fellowships are open to researchers of any nationality; no nationality restriction applies for EF applicants.
Entities controlled by non-eligible countries may be excluded from participation unless appropriate guarantees are provided to the contracting authority.

Global Postdoctoral Fellowships are open to European nationals or long-term residents only; third-country nationals who are not long-term residents in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country are not eligible for GF.
Project activities are expected to start at TRL 2 and achieve TRL 5 by the end of the project.
European Postdoctoral Fellowship standard duration must be between 12 and 24 months.
Maximum EU contribution per project is €19,000,000. The indicative total topic budget is €38,000,000 for approximately 2 funded projects.
Global Postdoctoral Fellowship outgoing phase must be a minimum of 12 months and a maximum of 24 months, spent at a host organisation in a non-associated Third Country.

Financial support to third parties (FSTP) provisions: maximum €300,000 per third party in grant stage 2; maximum €2,250,000 per third party in grant stage 3; maximum €2,550,000 per third party overall across all stages.
Global Postdoctoral Fellowships require a mandatory 12-month return phase at a host organisation based in an EU Member State or a Horizon Europe Associated Country.

Eligible countries for participation are described in Annex B of the Work Programme General Annexes. Non-EU/non-Associated Countries not automatically eligible for funding may have specific national provisions per the Horizon Europe Programme Guide.
Admissibility conditions are described in Annex A and Annex E of the Horizon Europe Work Programme General Annexes.
Financial and operational capacity requirements are described in Annex C of the Work Programme General Annexes.

Specific eligibility conditions apply to MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships in research areas covered by the Euratom Research and Training Programme; organisations active in nuclear research must be established in an EU Member State or country associated to the Euratom Research and Training Programme.
The host beneficiary may be from either the academic or the non-academic sector; both sectors are explicitly stated as eligible host environments.

If the researcher is recruited from the non-academic sector, a non-academic placement must be implemented at a different non-academic host organisation established in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country.

conditions.description: Standard Horizon Europe RIA minimum consortium composition: at least 3 legal entities from at least 3 different EU Member States or associated countries.
conditions.assumption_note: Minimum consortium size and composition are not stated in any of the topic-specific source documents (HORIZON-CL4-2026-05-DIGITAL-EMERGING-02.slice.json, HORIZON-CL4-2026-05-DIGITAL-EMERGING-02.json, or selected_call.json). This reflects the standard Horizon Europe General Annex B participation condition for Research and Innovation Actions. Verification against General Annex B (Tier 1) is required before treating this as a binding project eligibility constraint.
